'''DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017''' is the model now serving on the [[rtx-pro-6000|RTX PRO 6000s]].<ref>[https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 model card]</ref> The card ships no Jinja chat template; prompts must be built with its <code>encoding.py</code>.

== Why it isn't a training target ==
At roughly 750B parameters in total, it doesn't fit in our combined memory for training, even with an FP8 base.

== How it helps anyway ==
{{youtube 0VLAoVGf_74 ''How DeepSeek Rewrote the Transformer'': the MLA attention behind DeepSeek's models|Welch Labs}}

* '''Judge''': grade or rank attempts that code can't check. See [[llm-judge]].
* '''Teacher''': it already drives about 9,500 of our [[sitegeist-usage|Sitegeist calls]]. Its successful trajectories on our tasks could give a small model a short SFT warm start when the small model never succeeds on its own. See [[roadmap]].
* '''Task writer''': generate variations of [[browser-agent-bench]] tasks.
